headlines.title: Arsenal eye Real's Endrick - Wednesday's gossip
headlines.description: Real Madrid forward Endrick is on Arsenal's radar, Liverpool right-back Jeremie Frimpong is not headed for the Anfield exit door, Newcastle and Sunderland among the clubs interested in Croatian striker Dion Beljo, plus more.

headlines.title: Wenger considers standing against Infantino
headlines.description: Former Arsenal manager Arsene Wenger is considering standing against Gianni Infantino as a candidate in Fifa's presidential election in March.

headlines.title: People don't know full story behind England exile - White
headlines.description: Arsenal defender Ben White says people don't know the "full story" behind his decision to previously make himself unavailable for England selection - but says he would make the same decision again.
